cases.input: One instrument is calibrated against pinned standards and method.
cases.expect: Results, uncertainty, decision and certificate bindings are retained.
cases.violates: Method, standards and units are pinned.

cases.expect: Historical evidence remains while current fitness support ceases.
cases.violates: Expiry ends fitness support without deleting history.

cases.expect: Dependent fitness is invalidated pending recalibration.

cases.input: All instruments of the same model inherit one result.
cases.violates: Calibration never transfers to sibling instances.

cases.input: Calibration creates an unconditional permanent fitness property.
cases.violates: Fitness is derived for a stated use.

cases.input: A conformity result omits required uncertainty.
The candidate references WM-KNW-013, WM-REC-010 and WM-REC-001 as method, decision and certificate targets although no admitted evidence supplies them.
cases.expect: The reference targets are rejected and replaced by unresolved role slots.
cases.violates: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

cases.input: configurationRef is resolved by allocating a new configuration model instead of citing the reserved WM-OBJ-023 boundary.
cases.expect: The allocation is rejected and the dependency remains open.
cases.violates: WM-OBJ-023 is the reserved measuring-instrument/configuration boundary, is a completion dependency of EM-OPS-03, and receives no allocation here.

cases.input: The candidate declares completionDependencies WM-OBJ-023 and leaves configurationRef resolution open.
cases.expect: The candidate remains valid, incomplete and explicitly non-publishable.
cases.violates: WM-OBJ-023 is the reserved measuring-instrument/configuration boundary, is a completion dependency of EM-OPS-03, and receives no allocation here.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-034 assessment of instrument condition is registered as the calibration event itself.
cases.violates: WM-MAT-008 observations and WM-ACT-034 assessments may be cited as evidence and never constitute event identity.

cases.input: A conformity statement is issued with no decisionRule recorded.
cases.violates: Determination, decision and attestation remain separable.

cases.input: Results are released without calibratedRange or calibrationPoints.
cases.violates: Range and calibration points are explicit.

cases.input: validityState is set to valid while validityConditions are absent.
cases.violates: Expiry ends fitness support without deleting history.

cases.input: A declared break in the traceability chain is recorded and dependent fitness is left asserted.
A single lifecycle state encodes determination, conformity decision, attestation and validity together.
cases.violates: The four lifecycle axes advance independently and no single state may encode determination, decision, attestation and validity together.

cases.input: An event records determinationState evaluated, decisionState nonconforming, attestationState attested and validityState valid.
cases.expect: All four axes are stored separately and the nonconforming decision does not withdraw the attestation.
cases.violates: Determination, decision and attestation remain separable.

cases.input: A certificate artifact is treated as the calibration event, with no event record created.
cases.violates: A certificate is the immutable artifact of exactly one calibration event and never substitutes for the event.
